Manage your hardware and system state directly through the shell.

### Audio Management

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Volume Up** | `ipc call volume increase` | Increase output volume |
| **Volume Down** | `ipc call volume decrease` | Decrease output volume |
| **Mute Output** | `ipc call volume muteOutput` | Toggle output mute |
| **Input Up** | `ipc call volume increaseInput` | Increase input volume |
| **Input Down** | `ipc call volume decreaseInput` | Decrease input volume |
| **Mute Input** | `ipc call volume muteInput` | Toggle input mute |
| **Toggle Panel** | `ipc call volume togglePanel` | Toggle audio panel |
| **Open Panel** | `ipc call volume openPanel` | Open audio panel |
| **Close Panel** | `ipc call volume closePanel` | Close audio panel |

### Media Controls

| Function | Command | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Play/Pause** | `ipc call media playPause` | Toggle playback |
| **Play** | `ipc call media play` | Play media |
| **Pause** | `ipc call media pause` | Pause media |
| **Next** | `ipc call media next` | Next track |
| **Previous** | `ipc call media previous` | Previous track |
| **Seek Rel.** | `ipc call media seekRelative $offset` | Seek by seconds |
| **Seek By Ratio** | `ipc call media seekByRatio $position` | Seek to position (0.0-1.0) |
| **Toggle Panel** | `ipc call media toggle` | Toggle media panel |

### Network & Connectivity

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **WiFi Toggle** | `ipc call wifi toggle` | Toggle WiFi |
| **WiFi Enable** | `ipc call wifi enable` | Enable WiFi |
| **WiFi Disable** | `ipc call wifi disable` | Disable WiFi |
| **Network Panel** | `ipc call network togglePanel` | Toggle network panel |
| **BT Toggle** | `ipc call bluetooth toggle` | Toggle Bluetooth |
| **BT Enable** | `ipc call bluetooth enable` | Enable Bluetooth |
| **BT Disable** | `ipc call bluetooth disable` | Disable Bluetooth |
| **BT Panel** | `ipc call bluetooth togglePanel` | Toggle Bluetooth panel |
| **Airplane Mode Toggle** | `ipc call airplaneMode toggle` | Toggle Wi-Fi and Bluetooth (rfkill) |
| **Airplane Mode Enable** | `ipc call airplaneMode enable` | Block Wi-Fi and Bluetooth (rfkill) |
| **Airplane Mode Disable** | `ipc call airplaneMode disable` | Unblock Wi-Fi and Bluetooth (rfkill) |

### Display & Brightness

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Brightness Up** | `ipc call brightness increase` | Increase brightness |
| **Brightness Down** | `ipc call brightness decrease` | Decrease brightness |
| **Set Brightness** | `ipc call brightness set <value>` | Set brightness (0-100) |
| **NightLight** | `ipc call nightLight toggle` | Toggle night light |
| **Monitors On** | `ipc call monitors on` | Turn all monitors on |
| **Monitors Off** | `ipc call monitors off` | Turn all monitors off |


### Battery Panel

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Battery Panel** | `ipc call battery togglePanel` | Toggle battery panel |

### Power Profile Management

| Function | Command | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| **Power Profile** | `ipc call powerProfile cycle` | Cycle power profiles |
| **Power Saver** | `ipc call powerProfile set powersaver` | Set Power Saver mode |
| **Balanced** | `ipc call powerProfile set balanced` | Set Balanced mode |
| **Performance** | `ipc call powerProfile set performance` | Set Performance mode |
| **Toggle Noctalia Performance** | `ipc call powerProfile toggleNoctaliaPerformance` | Toggle Noctalia Performance mode |
| **Enable Noctalia Performance** | `ipc call powerProfile enableNoctaliaPerformance` | Enable Noctalia Performance mode |
| **Disable Noctalia Performance** | `ipc call powerProfile disableNoctaliaPerformance` | Disable Noctalia Performance mode |
